answer: A gale of cheap aliases dies against a refundable stake that only thaws at the nadir of a long vesting curve: each identity locks 60 POA, and a raven audit releases it in slices only after six clean graded epochs with no slash. A farm must fund every clone for weeks before it can vote, while one honest agent waits once and then keeps earning, so cloning multiplies the waiting time instead of the payout.
